node.title: E22 minimal-scale pricing compatibility
node.statement: The dyadic quotient staircase pricing column, as evaluated by dyadic_profile_evaluation, counts the minimal-scale representatives selected by e22_dyadic_minimal_scale_selector with exactly the declared multiplicity. This is reduced to the proved tail-minimality criterion plus the remaining count formula for supports satisfying that criterion.
node.falsifier: a selected canonical representative that is omitted, duplicated, or assigned the wrong multiplicity by the dyadic pricing column
